text:
Additional   exercises


                     The Commissioner  of the Dublin police force has revealed that they have received a death threat
                  E
                     against the life of President Nabon, who is visiting the capital this weekend. He says that they
                     are taking the threat very seriously. People expect that security levels will be increased during the
                               visit.

                     Someone  found a man  injured on a Scottish hillside this morning. People think that he fell while
                     coming down a  hillside in bad weather. Medical staff are treating him in hospital for leg and head
                     injuries. Someone reported him missing last night when he failed to return home after a day’s
                     walking.

                     And now  football. People expect that there will be a record crowd at    match  between
                     Barcelona and Real Madrid. People report that the club will give the Barcelona players a huge
                     financial bonus if they win and people have even suggested that the club might pay them as
                     much  as €50,000 each.


            Verb  complementation:      what  follows   verbs
                                                                                                 Units 30  &  31


                  Underline the correct option. Sometimes  both are possible.
                     He insisted to pay / on paying for the meal.
                  1
                     The interviewer started off to ask / by asking me why | wanted the job.

                     | can clearly recall his saying / him saying that he was meeting Sarah at eight o’clock.
                     The university has arranged / appointed Dr Lopez to be head of the new Medical Institute.
                     | knew | could ask / count on Hannah if | needed any help.
                     My parents are always going on at me to tidy / for to tidy up my bedroom.
                     The ticket enables you visiting / to visit both the museum and the art gallery.
                     Fatima is so small that she often has to resort to wearing children’s clothes / children’s clothes to
                     get the right size.
                     We objected to their cat / their cat’s digging up our garden.
                  wo
                     The government  plans to bring in new laws forcing / making parents to take more responsibility
                     for the education of their children.
                     | don’t approve of her wearing / wearing outdoor shoes in the house.
                 11
                     Ramos  was arrested when he failed him to appear / to appear in court.
                 12
                     If you have any problems with the computer, contact Simon. It’s best if you allow / let him deal
                 13
                     with them.
                     I've heard a lot about Dr Lau, and I’m looking forward to hearing / to hear his talk tomorrow.
                 14
                     Although Carmen  is a doctor herself, it doesn’t entitle her to / entitle for her to special treatment,
                 15
                     and she will have to join the waiting list like everyone else.
                     We waited / waited for the storm to pass before we continued.
                 16
                     When | was in the supermarket | noticed a man to take / noticed a man take a packet off the shelf
                 17
                     and hide it inside his coat.
                     We invited / refused Lisa to come to the party.
                 18
                     | overheard her tell / telling Aleksi that she was seriously ill.
                 19
                     She gave up work so that she could focus on looking / look after her children.
                 20
                     We were  unhappy in England, and even discussed / talked of emigrating to New Zealand.
                 21
                     The lizard is amazingly well adapted to live / to living in very dry and windy conditions.
                 22
                     Another increase in the price of petrol would discourage me from using / from using my car.
